lessons.trigger_condition: After card measurement, expected grade and generation were visible but users still had to interpret multiple market rows manually; naive aggregation could let one marketplace with many listings dominate the displayed reference price.
lessons.prevention_rule: For a trade reference, require exact card-number identity and compatible edition/variant, select one strongest evidence tier, collapse each source to its median, then take the median across source medians; expose every contributing/reference source price and hold the recommendation when identity or evidence is ambiguous.
validation_required: card measurement cockpit shows recommended trade reference, observed range, and exact predicted-PSA reference when available
source price cards show where each observed price came from and whether it contributes to the recommendation
completed sales outrank API reference prices and asking prices without mixing weaker tiers upward
one marketplace with many rows cannot dominate because recommendation uses per-source medians before the cross-source median
name-only or ambiguous variant searches never fabricate an aggregate recommendation
existing grading calibration and non-core grading safety boundaries remain unchanged
lessons.safety_boundary: No missing price or exact-grade value is invented; ambiguous identity/variant is HOLD, asking prices remain lower-priority reference evidence, and non-core grading remains disabled.
